steps.pick: radius.8: We use an 8px corner for buttons and inputs in order to mark their role as controls in a warm tone, by brand convention. A rounded radius does this by curving the edge enough to feel soft, while the sides stay straight. So controls feel friendly next to long text and never compete with it, because the brand is warm (brand.q1), corners are rounded (shape.values) and each screen holds one idea (content.q2).

steps.pick: navy.light.100: a tint of the brand, 1.22:1 from content, always beside its edge (border.selected), so selection is never color alone.
